name: 赢家
overview: When heiress Liang Meng dies, Lin Qing assumes her identity and enters the powerful Longquan family. Surrounded by scheming relatives and closely watched by Zhao Jia'an, she must keep her secret hidden while navigating a world of wealth, ambition, and betrayal. As the risks of exposure mount, Lin Qing evolves from an overlooked pawn into a formidable player determined to control her own fate.
